title: Spotlight editor snaps to frame both ways, like the Space page editor

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): 'the same feature we have in space editors where when you click on an element whatever you are editing snaps to frame.' Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/WX5fSWaGKNuKhe8iXbPSYf, phase 2.

detail: Picking a block in the Spotlight editor scrolls the preview to it and outlines it; picking a link opens on that link. A press on the preview picks that block, or that link's row, in the editor and brings the row into view; hover outlines what a press would pick. Blocks are stamped with their node id only on the preview render (visitor renders unchanged); a link drawn by a theme's own layout is matched by its address (lib/spotlight/preview-target.ts). A press in the preview is never counted as a visitor click.

verify.note: Fails while a pick in either pane does not reach the other.
